# `particle_voice/nn/core/ParticleTensorView.js`

> **Source:** `agi/particle_voice/nn/core/ParticleTensorView.js`

ParticleTensorView.js — Phase 1 ParticleNN core. A zero-copy view over a parent `ParticleTensor`'s GPU buffer: a different logical shape/strides/byte-offset into the SAME underlying buffer, with no `device.queue` copy and no new buffer allocation. Used for things like binding a single weight page's sub-range, or reading one layer's slice out of a stacked activation tensor, without a `copyBufferToBuffer` pass.

## Classes

### `class ParticleTensorView`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(parent, shape, elementOffset = 0)` |  |
| `buffer` | `get buffer()` | The GPUBuffer this view reads/writes — identical object as the parent's, never copied. |
| `asBindingResource` | `asBindingResource()` | `{ buffer, offset, size }` suitable for a `GPUBindGroupEntry.resource` with dynamic offset support. |
| `getData` | `async getData()` | Read just this view's bytes back to a host typed array (still a real copy — GPU readback always is — but no intermediate buffer duplication on the GPU side). |

## Notes & Examples

### Where this fits in the training loop

AGI runs an **observation → brain → action → reward** loop each tick: observations are gathered from the world, a brain maps them to actions, the rig applies motion, and rewards shape the next update.

**Example: Minimal training loop**
```js
import { Agent } from 'agi/core/Agent.js';
import { World } from 'agi/env/World.js';

const world = new World();
const agent = new Agent({
  brain: 'ppo',
  observationSpace: world.observationSpace,
  actionSpace: world.actionSpace
});

for (let step = 0; step < 10000; step++) {
  const obs = world.getObservation();      // Gather observations
  const action = agent.act(obs);            // Brain decides action
  const { reward, done } = world.step(action); // Apply action, get reward
  agent.learn(obs, action, reward);         // Update from experience
  
  if (done) world.reset();
}
```

**See also:** [AGI Training Guide](/agi/training-guide.md) · [AGI Architecture](/agi/architecture.md)
